97|             batch size of each GPU.

99|             for each GPU.

101|         dist (bool): Distributed training/test or not. Default: True.
102|         shuffle (bool): Whether to shuffle the data at every epoch.
103|             Default: True.

118|             dataset, world_size, rank, shuffle=shuffle)
119|         shuffle = False
120|         batch_size = samples_per_gpu
121|         num_workers = workers_per_gpu
122|     else:
123|         sampler = None

125|         num_workers = num_gpus * workers_per_gpu
